notes.title: Lamu Stream
notes.notes: Shape the destiny of your village! The magic orb, once guarded by the wise old wizard, has disappeared, leaving your village defenseless. Farm, collect crystals, aid the wizard, and restore the orb's magic. However, every night, dark forces intensify, seeking to thwart your mission.
